sdkDependencies.policy: Top-level dependencies[] is the explicit dependency SDK family contract for this gateway.

dependencyApiSurfaces.policy: Top-level apiSurfaces[] plus dependencies[] are the explicit dependency API surface contract.

resolvedDedup.reason: platform infrastructure ownership: nginx/servers/audit_logs management belongs to sdkwork-deployments; sdkwork-webserver keeps the surface for its standalone host but excludes it from cloud composition via ApiAssemblyContext::cloud_gateway() (API_ASSEMBLY_SPEC 4.2.2)

assemblyIntegrationPoint.context: process-shared DatabasePool plus host-neutral topology and provider ports
assemblyIntegrationPoint.consumerPolicy: foundation features depend on exactly one owner API assembly and never on dependency route, service, repository, provider-adapter, or database-host crates

sharedUtilities.usage: boolean env toggles and HTTP path normalization in gateway runtime

rules: sdkwork-iam-app-api is restricted to appbase IAM dependency route patterns
sdkwork-iam-backend-api is restricted to backend IAM dependency route patterns
sdkwork-iam-open-api owns OAuth, provider callback, and discovery document routes declared by the IAM open assembly
specific dependency route patterns must resolve before broad fallback dependency prefixes when prefixes overlap
broad app or backend prefixes are accepted only when dependencyRoutes restrict ownership to assembly-declared route patterns
sdkwork-im-app-api owns the declared /app/v3/api IM routes, sdkwork-im-backend-api owns the control-plane routes, and sdkwork-im-open-api exclusively owns /im/v3/api

sdkwork-im-realtime-plane owns the /im/v3/api/realtime/ws WebSocket upgrade surface and hosts the session-gateway realtime plane per ADR-20260809-platform-gateway-realtime-hosting; link transport binds are server-side declarations, not HTTP ingress
sdkwork-cloudrouter app, backend, and open authorities expose only their declared non-overlapping prefixes through one embedded assembly
non-appbase dependency surfaces route by apiPrefix/{*path}

workspace foundation dependency surfaces are added only when existing SDK assembly plus materialized OpenAPI paths or normalized route manifest evidence provides a stable route prefix; empty or generic-only SDK assemblies are not gateway startup dependencies
one dependency SDK family may declare multiple apiPrefixes when its materialized path set spans multiple stable prefixes; all prefixes share the same serviceId and executable assembly
foundation dependency executable evidence is declared through Cargo workspace dependencies and runtime Cargo features
dependency surfaces must declare cargoFeature, cargoDependency, and an executable assembly export
owner assemblies manage route, service, repository, database lifecycle, readiness, and retained runtime handles behind one public bootstrap
the platform cloud gateway provides the process-shared database pool and host-neutral context but never imports dependency-owned database-host crates
do not maintain a separate gateway catalog when Cargo metadata and SDKWork specs already describe the integration
embedded routers own matched dependency HTTP and WebSocket routes

cors.embeddedModeAuthority: embedded dependency routers own request-context middleware and the platform gateway owns outer CORS

rules: observability access/audit sample rates must be between 0 and 10000 basis points
request.maxBodyBytes and policy.rules[].maxBodyBytes must be greater than 0
dependencySurfaces[].serviceId and dependencySurfaces[].apiPrefix must be non-empty
traffic.rateLimits[].id, traffic.concurrencyLimits[].id, and policy.rules[].id must be non-empty
traffic.concurrencyLimits[].maxInFlight must be greater than 0

accessLog.failureClassPolicy: bounded gateway failure classes only; no raw path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address values

auditLog.classificationPolicy: bounded security and traffic decision values; no token, tenant, user, or IP address values

metrics.labelPolicy: bounded labels only; no raw path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address labels

diagnostics.exclusionPolicy: no raw request paths, request ids, trace ids, headers, tokens, tenant, user, organization, IP address, or live request data

secureHeaders.embeddedModeBaselineAuthority: embedded route assemblies plus the platform outer security layer

backends.name: redis
backends.scope: atomic cluster-wide token buckets via Lua (traffic.redisUrl); unreachable Redis falls back to in-process buckets with a rate_limit_redis_fallbacks_total metric

metrics.scopePolicy: policy rule id only; no raw request path, request id, trace id, token, tenant, user, or IP address labels

dryRunBehavior: allowedMethods violations are forwarded and counted as method_not_allowed dry-run observations
policy maxBodyBytes overrides do not replace request.maxBodyBytes while dryRun is true
Content-Length values above a matching policy maxBodyBytes are counted as request_body_too_large dry-run observations

embeddedMode.dependencyRouters: own request-context, authentication, and authorization middleware
